messages:
eli: DeployBot flagged RC8 canary for web-api:rc8 — SBOM provenance mismatch on image layer set. Canary quarantined automatically. Need immediate decision: pin to digest (rc8@sha256:...), rollback to rc7, or allow a fast-path exception? @diane @samir

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary deployment quarantined at 03:22:17 UTC — SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: missing provenance.signature for image web-api:rc8 (build 2026-03-20T02:58Z).

logan: Can we surface which layer or artifact failed verification?

deploy-bot: Failure detail: unsigned manifest for layer index 5, provenance.verified=false. Full event id: evt-20260320-7781.

samir: Quick context: rc8 contains third-party binary bump for the telemetry collector. Build pipeline used vendor-builder-2.1. We didn't have signed provenance enabled for that builder historically.

eli: Risk perspective: if we proceed, legal/compliance needs to approve a provenance exception. That could take hours. If we rollback to rc7 we lose the telemetry change but preserve release window. Thoughts?

diane: Suggest rollback to rc7 for now. Open an exception ticket for rc8 provenance gap and run a re-build with signed provenance on hotfix branch. If vendor can't sign, escalate to supply-chain review.

samir: Agreed on rollback. Also propose we set an emergency fast-path for non-executable-only SBOM mismatches where qscore < 3 and canary error rate < 0.5% — but that needs policy approval from security/compliance.

logan: For transparency: propose we add a short release note entry and mark rc8 as quarantined with reason SBOM provenance mismatch + link to incident ticket.

eli: Can we get a one-liner command to reproduce the verify step? I want eng-oncall to re-run verification before rollback to confirm no flakiness.

security-bot: Recommended verification command:
```
cosign verify-blob --signature sig.pub --artifact web-api:rc8 manifest.json
```
Run in pipeline-runner account.

samir: I re-ran the verify in staging — same failure. It reports unsigned manifest for layer 5. Not a transient network error.

diane: OK rolling back plan: 1) Pause release, 2) Trigger rollback to web-api:rc7 across canaries, 3) Create presigned hotfix branch build: rc8-hotfix-signing, re-run provenance & SBOM, 4) If signed provenance present, request compliance sign-off, 5) reattempt canary next change window.

eli: Action items assigned: @logan file the incident ticket with logs and add to release notes; @samir create rc8-hotfix-signing build and coordinate with infra to enable cosign signing; @diane draft exception request in compliance if vendor can't sign. I'll post rollback command now.

eli: Rollback command: `deployctl rollback --service web-api --to-tag rc7 --reason "sbom provenance mismatch: rc8 quarantined" --urgency immediate` (running now).

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollback initiated at 03:27:34 UTC. Canary srv-web-api-1 set to rc7. Observability: will monitor error rate for 15m.

logan: Filed ticket REL-2026-412 with logs and initial triage notes. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/REL-2026-412 (added release note stub).

samir: Started rc8-hotfix-signing job (pipeline 5589). Will follow up when cosign completes.

diane: Thanks team. We'll treat this as a supply-chain incident and keep release window intact. If hotfix proves signed and validated within the change window, we can requeue rc8 as a patch rollout.

eli: Closing thread for coordination; I'll post final status once pipeline finishes. :thumbsup:
